name: two-tip
title: Two tip
description: Zenith's starter example auto (examples/starter collect-and-score), tuned to BioHORS: shoot the four preloads from the south, which tips the hive (3 nectar staged in the up cell); go round the west of the hive to flower1 and score its four in the north cell; sweep the RED garden line west and score its four north for the second tip. The flower bar goes down for every pickup.

steps.notes: A straight line north to the scoring spot south of the hive, facing its up cell.

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Volley 1: the four preloads into the south cell; the third tips it (3 nectar staged there, season tip table) and the fourth goes in as it starts to swing.

control.provenance: SET BY HAND: the starter example's first control point moved 6 in west and 4 in south, tuned to BioHORS: the 22 in robot clears the hive frame's west bar as it turns

PLACEHOLDER: starter example, a curve control point that takes the robot around the west of the hive frame, clear of its west bar and legs, so the whole footprint stays on RED's side of the centre line

PLACEHOLDER: starter example, a curve control point that takes the robot around the west of the hive frame, clear of its west bar and legs, so the whole footprint stays on RED's side of the centre line

steps.notes: After the tip the up cell faces north, and a launch only scores from the up cell's own quarter of the field, so the robot goes to the other side of the hive. It goes around the west of the hive frame, not under it: the frame's west legs keep an 18 in robot's centre east of about x = -9, and its footprint is 18 in wide, so under the hive it would cross the centre line into BLUE's side (G402). It keeps facing north while it leaves the scoring spot, turns to drive nose-first once its footprint is clear of the centre line, and turns back to face north for the flower.

steps.name: intakeOn
steps.notes: Starts the intake before the flower. (Pedro 3.0.2 cannot run Zenith's mid-path markers, so the starter's t = 0 marker is a command first.)

steps.name: flowerBarDown
steps.notes: Puts the flower bar down to reach into flower1's opening.

Drives slowly up to flower1 with the intake running. The marker starts the intake as the path starts, without a separate step; endCondition ends the path early once the robot is full, and expect tells the ledger it takes the flower's four pollen. Heading held square to the wall (a tangent heading turns a small sideways offset into a yaw that swings the mouth off the opening).
Gives the intake up to one more second. A wait until ends as soon as its condition is true, and timeoutS stops it waiting forever.

steps.name: flowerBarStow
steps.notes: Folds the flower bar up before backing off.
Backs straight off flower1 still facing it, before the starter's curve turns the robot: turning next to the flower's foot swings the 22 in robot's corner into it.

control.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: starter example, a curve control point that takes the robot around the west of the hive frame, clear of its west bar and legs, so the whole footprint stays on RED's side of the centre line

SET BY HAND: starter example, a curve control point on x = -13, the scoring spots' line, that takes the robot around the west of the hive frame, clear of its west bar and legs, so the whole footprint stays on RED's side of the centre line

steps.notes: Backs off the flower, turns around and comes in to the scoring spot north of the hive from the north, so the launcher faces the up cell when it gets there. It does the turn while it is still west of x = -13, so its footprint stays on RED's side of the centre line.

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Volley 2: four flower pollen into the north cell (up after tip 1).

control.provenance: SET BY HAND: the starter example's first control point moved north-west, tuned to BioHORS: the 22 in robot heads away from the hive frame before turning south
SET BY HAND: the starter example's middle control point moved down the west side, tuned to BioHORS: the 22 in robot stays west of the hive frame's bar and legs
SET BY HAND: the starter example's last control point moved east of the end point, tuned to BioHORS: the curve then arrives heading west, square to the south wall

steps.notes: The starter's curve back south round the west of the hive, tuned to BioHORS (CAD footprint: bar tip 14.2 in ahead of the drive centre, back 7.8 in behind, 17.84 in wide); ending heading west above the garden lane instead of turning to west on it.
Slides down onto the garden lane still facing west, slowly so it stops on time: near the south wall the 22 in robot must stay square to it.

steps.name: intakeOn
steps.notes: Starts the intake before the sweep. (Pedro 3.0.2 cannot run Zenith's mid-path markers, so the starter's t = 0 marker is a command first.)

steps.name: flowerBarDown
steps.notes: Puts the flower bar down for the garden sweep too.

The starter's sweep west along the RED garden line, intake toward the red alliance wall, taking the pollen in a line. It always runs to its end: cut short when full, the robot rolls on into the west wall.
Up to 0.8 s more for the last pollen.

steps.name: flowerBarStow
steps.notes: Folds the flower bar up.
Up off the lane still facing west (square to the south wall), to where it can turn.

control.provenance: SET BY HAND: the starter example's (Zenith examples/starter collect-and-score), first control point moved off the garden lane, tuned to BioHORS (CAD footprint: bar tip 14.2 in ahead of the drive centre, back 7.8 in behind, 17.84 in wide)

PLACEHOLDER: starter example, a curve control point that takes the robot around the west of the hive frame, clear of its west bar and legs, so the whole footprint stays on RED's side of the centre line

SET BY HAND: starter example, a curve control point on x = -13, the scoring spots' line, that takes the robot around the west of the hive frame, clear of its west bar and legs, so the whole footprint stays on RED's side of the centre line

steps.notes: North around the west of the frame, east along the north side of the hive and down to the scoring spot north of it, turning to face the up cell. It does the turn west of x = -13, and the last stretch is a straight drive south, so its footprint stays on RED's side of the centre line (G402).

A deadline group ends when its deadline member, the drive, ends. The sequence beside it keeps the intake on for half a second while the robot leaves the garden, then stops it and spins the launcher up on the way back.

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Four more pollen into the north cell, which now holds 8, so the hive tips a second time.
